title: Contact a support agent
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2025-05-06
html:
📌 Note: Live chat support agents are currently only available for the US market. For non-US market support, please submit a ticket instead. In the Partner Center Console, navigate to the Help Center located at the bottom of the left-hand navigation panel:

For TikTok Shop Partners (TSPs)

As a TSP, you may contact support on behalf of a seller. In the Help Center, select the option to Get support for a shop: You will be prompted with the following set of drop-down menus:

  1. For Target Market, select the United States.
  2. For Service, select your correct TSP service.
  3. For Shop ID, select the correct seller from the drop-down menu, or manually input the corresponding Shop ID.

❗ Important: If you can't find the correct Shop ID, the shop has most likely not authorized you to contact support on their behalf. Please visit the FAQs - How can a seller authorize a TSP to contact support at the bottom of this guide.

  1. Select Start Chat
  2. A new chat window will open to connect with a seller support agent:

For Creator Agency Partners (CAPs)/Multi-Channel Networks (MCNs)

In the Help Center, select the option to Get support for a creator: You will be prompted with the follow set of drop-down menus:

  1. For Target Market, select the United States.
  2. For Creator Username, select the correct creator.
  3. Select Start Chat.
  4. A new chat window will open to connect with a creator support agent:

FAQs

How can a seller authorize a TSP to contact support on their behalf?

  1. The TSP should navigate to Partner Center > Apps and Services > Copy authorization link:

  1. Send the authorization link to the seller. If they are a new seller, ensure they check the box to Submit a ticket for me during authorization:

Existing sellers will be presented with an authorization renewal prompt, where they will be able to check the same box to Submit a ticket for me:
